findings.source_passage: This young fellow's healthy cheek is like a sun-toasted pear in hue, and would seem to smell almost as musky; he cannot have been three days landed from his Indian voyage. That man next him looks a few shades lighter; you might say a touch of satin wood is in him. In the complexion of a third still lingers a tropic tawn, but slightly bleached withal
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'You could pretty plainly tell how long each one had been ashore'
findings.why_it_matters: This extended impressionistic catalogue—sun-toasted pear, satin wood, tropic tawn—is stylistically distinctive voice-establishing prose, and the rhetorical build from figure to figure is signature Melville. The draft jumps directly from the topic sentence to the Queequeg climax, erasing all intermediate texture.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore at least the first two figures ('sun-toasted pear' and 'satin wood') before the Queequeg comparison; the progression is essential to the rhetorical effect of the payoff line.

findings.source_passage: here were a set of sea-dogs, many of whom without the slightest bashfulness had boarded great whales on the high seas—entire strangers to them—and duelled them dead without winking; and yet, here they sat at a social breakfast table—all of the same calling, all of kindred tastes—looking round as sheepishly at each other as though they had never been out of sight of some sheepfold among the Green Mountains
findings.source_locator: paragraph beginning 'These reflections just here are occasioned by the circumstance'
findings.why_it_matters: This ironic contrast—men who duelled whales dead without winking now sheepish among kindred company—is the interpretive and comic heart of the silence passage; it establishes the whaleman's paradox of boldness and social awkwardness that recurs in the novel.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-insert the ironic contrast between whale-fighting boldness and breakfast-table bashfulness before the summary line 'A curious sight; these bashful bears.'

summary: Two medium-severity voice-flattening losses (the graduated cheek-colour catalogue and the ironic whale-duelling contrast) weaken the segment's rhetorical texture but do not individually meet the regeneration threshold; two medium findings keep the verdict at pass.
